stem.text: In the circuits shown, the cell has negligible internal resistance.
Which diagram shows a potential divider circuit that can vary the potential difference (p.d.) across the lamp?

A.alt: Circuit with a cell, a variable resistor in a vertical branch, and a lamp in series with the branch on the right.

B.alt: Circuit with a cell, a variable resistor in a vertical branch on the right, and a lamp connected below it.

C.alt: Circuit with a cell, a resistor with a sliding contact whose arrow connects to a lamp on the right.

D.alt: Circuit with a cell, a resistor with a sliding contact on its left whose arrow connects to the top wire, and a lamp on the right.
